records.rationale: Much obliged is a conventional complete appreciation idiom.

records.originalText: I wish to express my deep appreciation for your kindness.
records.finalText: I wish to express my deep appreciation for your kindness.
records.rationale: Repeats 54409's gratitude-for-kindness function through a formal paraphrase.

records.originalText: I cannot thank you enough for all your kindness.
records.finalText: I cannot thank you enough for all your kindness.
records.rationale: Another gratitude-for-kindness expression repeats 54409 without an independent act.

records.originalText: I cannot thank you enough for your kindness.
records.finalText: I cannot thank you enough for your kindness.
records.rationale: Repeats 54411's gratitude sentence with only all omitted.

records.originalText: It's kind of you to say so.
records.finalText: It's kind of you to say so.
records.rationale: Repeats the published kind-of-you-to-say-so appreciation expression.

records.originalText: I cannot thank you enough for your assistance.
records.finalText: I cannot thank you enough for your assistance.
records.rationale: Repeats the generic gratitude-for-help function through a cannot-thank-enough variant.

records.originalText: I am more than grateful to you for your help.
records.finalText: I am more than grateful to you for your help.
records.rationale: Another grateful-for-help variant adds no independent assistance event.

records.originalText: I greatly appreciate your advice.
records.finalText: I greatly appreciate your advice.
records.rationale: The gratitude specifically identifies advice as its appreciated contribution.

records.originalText: Please give my best regards to your husband.
records.finalText: Please give my best regards to your husband.
records.rationale: Repeats the published give-my-regards message request with another recipient.

records.originalText: Please make sure that your seat belt is securely fastened.
records.finalText: Please make sure that your seat belt is securely fastened.
records.rationale: Securely fastened seat-belt check is complete contextual passenger-safety speech.

records.originalText: Why don't you make it yourself?
records.finalText: Why don't you make it yourself?
records.rationale: Natural complete proposal to make something independently is grammatical.

records.originalText: I congratulate you on your engagement.
records.finalText: I congratulate you on your engagement.
records.rationale: The engagement supplies a clear occasion for a conventional congratulation.

records.originalText: We have just received an inquiry from Kansas concerning your brother.
records.finalText: We have just received an inquiry from Kansas concerning your brother.
records.rationale: A particular inquiry's origin and subject form a complete correspondence account.

records.originalText: Thank you in advance for your help.
records.finalText: Thank you in advance for your help.
records.rationale: In advance explicitly distinguishes prospective assistance acknowledgment from completed gratitude.

records.originalText: Thank you for your kind assistance.
records.finalText: Thank you for your kind assistance.
records.rationale: Repeats the existing thank-you-for-help appreciation function without a specific act.

records.originalText: When you decide which plan you want, please notify us in writing.
records.finalText: When you decide which plan you want, please notify us in writing.
records.rationale: The plan-choice condition and written-notification instruction are coherent.

records.originalText: How many are there in your party, sir?
records.finalText: How many are there in your party, sir?
records.rationale: Exact pragmatic repeat of the published how-many-people-in-your-party service question.

records.originalText: I am willing to agree to your request.
records.finalText: I am willing to agree to your request.
records.rationale: Willing to agree is a grammatical complete expression of consent to a request.

records.originalText: They might pay me more if I could use a computer.
records.finalText: They might pay me more if I could use a computer.
records.rationale: The hypothetical computer ability and pay possibility form a correct conditional.

records.originalText: In order to use a computer, you must learn to type.
records.finalText: In order to use a computer, you must learn to type.
records.rationale: The categorical typing prerequisite overstates what all computer use requires.

records.originalText: A computer is a complex machine.
records.finalText: A computer is a complex machine.
records.rationale: The modest elementary computer-as-complex-machine description is stable.

records.originalText: Computers are capable of doing very complicated work in a split second.
records.finalText: Computers are capable of doing very complicated work in a split second.
records.rationale: The unspecified extremely complicated work and split-second capability overgeneralize computational performance.

records.originalText: A computer can calculate very rapidly.
records.finalText: A computer can calculate very rapidly.
records.rationale: Rapid calculation is a modest elementary computer capability, without a benchmark guarantee.

records.originalText: Computers can save us a lot of time and trouble.
records.finalText: Computers can save us a lot of time and trouble.
records.rationale: Can save time expresses a modest possibility rather than a universal productivity guarantee.

records.originalText: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
records.finalText: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
records.rationale: The extremely complicated work is undefined, leaving a sweeping technology-capability claim.

records.originalText: The operation of a computer keyboard requires less effort than that of a manual typewriter.
records.finalText: The operation of a computer keyboard requires less effort than that of a manual typewriter.
records.rationale: The keyboard-effort comparison lacks device models and an effort measurement scope.

records.originalText: It is an advantage to be able to use a computer.
records.finalText: It is an advantage to be able to use a computer.
records.rationale: A contextual computer-skill advantage is an ordinary subjective assessment.

records.originalText: Hi! Do you work here?
records.finalText: Hi! Do you work here?
records.rationale: Complete greeting and workplace question are natural direct speech.

records.originalText: I cannot entertain such a request.
records.finalText: I cannot entertain such a request.
records.rationale: Cannot entertain a request is a conventional formal refusal expression.

records.originalText: What did they add this needless function for?
records.finalText: What did they add this needless function for?
records.rationale: The complete question identifies a particular function and explicitly evaluates its utility.

records.originalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
records.finalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
records.rationale: Never have I correctly triggers inversion in a particular sunset-experience assessment.

records.originalText: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?
records.finalText: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?
records.rationale: Adds another unspecified beautiful-sunset experience variant after 54626.

records.originalText: Who'd have thought this is how the pieces fit?
records.finalText: Who'd have thought this is how the pieces fit?
records.rationale: The idiomatic who-would-have-thought question expresses surprise at a solution's arrangement.

records.originalText: How are you going to spend such a large amount of money?
records.finalText: How are you going to spend such a large amount of money?
records.rationale: The complete spending-plan question asserts no financial recommendation.

records.originalText: What on earth are you doing in such a lonely place?
records.finalText: What on earth are you doing in such a lonely place?
records.rationale: Repeats the published what-on-earth-are-you-doing-here question with a generic place descriptor.

records.originalText: I wanna get out of here!
records.finalText: I wanna get out of here!
records.rationale: Wanna is a valid informal spoken reduction in a complete departure wish.

records.originalText: Don't let such a good opportunity go by.
records.finalText: Don't let such a good opportunity go by.
records.rationale: Let an opportunity go by is a natural ordinary encouragement expression.

records.originalText: We should do away with this regulation.
records.finalText: We should do away with this regulation.
records.rationale: The regulation and justification for abolishing it are absent.

records.originalText: This is the coldest weather in ten years.
records.finalText: This is the coldest weather in ten years.
records.rationale: A contextual ten-year weather comparison is grammatical without a named location's record claim.

records.originalText: It's foolish for you to swim when it's this cold.
records.finalText: It's foolish for you to swim when it's this cold.
records.rationale: The unframed personal insult adds little suitable context beyond cold-weather swimming criticism.

records.originalText: I look for all the world like an athlete in this outfit, but the truth is I don't do any sports at all.
records.finalText: I look for all the world like an athlete in this outfit, but the truth is I don't do any sports at all.
records.rationale: For all the world and the contrast with no sport form coherent self-deprecating speech.

records.originalText: I wouldn't dream of going on a picnic on such a rainy day.
records.finalText: I wouldn't dream of going on a picnic on such a rainy day.
records.rationale: Would not dream of is a natural personal rainy-day picnic preference.

records.originalText: We have no chance against those top players.
records.finalText: We have no chance against those top players.
records.rationale: A particular team-opponent skill prediction is grammatical and contextual.

records.originalText: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
records.finalText: It's absolutely impossible for me to go on like this.
records.rationale: Like this omits the circumstances preventing continuation.

records.originalText: I have a strong objection to being treated like this.
records.finalText: I have a strong objection to being treated like this.
records.rationale: Objection to being treated correctly uses a passive gerund in a complete protest.

records.originalText: This is how I solved the difficult problem.
records.finalText: This is how I solved the difficult problem.
records.rationale: This is how omits the method of solving the problem.

records.originalText: This is how we reached the conclusion.
records.finalText: This is how we reached the conclusion.
records.rationale: This is how omits the reasoning used to reach the conclusion.

records.originalText: Mother told me that I had better not go out in such bad weather.
records.finalText: Mother told me that I had better not go out in such bad weather.
records.rationale: The reported bad-weather recommendation is grammatically coherent ordinary personal advice.

records.originalText: I'm ashamed to ask you such a silly question.
records.finalText: I'm ashamed to ask you such a silly question.
records.rationale: Ashamed to ask correctly uses an infinitive in a particular conversational hesitation.

records.originalText: I have seldom seen such a beautiful sunset as this.
records.finalText: I have seldom seen such a beautiful sunset as this.
records.rationale: Repeats 54626's unusually beautiful sunset-experience proposition with seldom.

records.originalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.
records.finalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful sight.
records.rationale: Repeats the negative-inversion beautiful-sight experience assessment without an independent scene.

records.originalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful picture.
records.finalText: Never have I seen such a beautiful picture.
records.rationale: Another beautiful-visual-object inversion variant adds no independent experience context.

records.originalText: I've never seen a pearl of such magnitude!
records.finalText: I've never seen a pearl of such magnitude!
records.rationale: The particular pearl-size exclamation correctly uses present-perfect experience.

records.originalText: How can I work with all these papers everywhere?
records.finalText: How can I work with all these papers everywhere?
records.rationale: The scattered papers explicitly anchor a natural work-obstruction question.

records.originalText: Jobs are hard to come by with so many people out of work.
records.finalText: Jobs are hard to come by with so many people out of work.
records.rationale: The labor-supply-to-job-availability claim lacks place, period and evidence.
